async classmethod create(home_addrs: list[str]) → Self[source]¶

Factory method to create a HomeController instance

Multiple subscriptions will be created to update the HOME controller cache using defined callbacks. This provides non-blocking updates to the HOME controller model.

Parameters:

home_addrs (list[str]) – List of HOME controller addresses.
